_readme: ACTIVE OFFERS — time-limited prices, promo codes and discount %s the compliance gate accepts in generated ad copy. The team edits this per campaign (Settings → Active Offers). 'expires' is an ISO date (inclusive, end of day) or null for open-ended; EXPIRED ENTRIES STOP VALIDATING IMMEDIATELY, so an expired code in copy gets stripped automatically. Evergreen brand facts do NOT belong here — they live in server/ai-studio/claim-gate.ts (APPROVED_BRAND_FACTS).

offers.note: Challenge entry price - SET AN EXPIRY when the campaign is time-limited
Welcome promo code - SET AN EXPIRY when the campaign is time-limited
